name: Savage Beating
body:
Your savage ferocity combines with primitive attacks to inflict more damage.

Prerequisite: Mahrog, BAB +8, Primeval Brutality, Str 17.

Benefit: You gain a +2 competence bonus to hit rolls made while using improvised weapons. If you have the Club and Spear feat, you may also apply this bonus to weapons affected by that feat.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
